title: Bangor CAS Interview
description: Practice your interview step by step and receive AI-powered feedback.

questions.question: Could you please tell me your name and date of birth?
questionVariations: Can you please introduce yourself by stating your full name and date of birth?
What is your full name, and when were you born?
Before we begin the interview, could you confirm your full name and date of birth?
questions.expectedAnswer: My name is Utsha Chandra Das, and my date of birth is 25 November 2000.

questions.question: What is your passport number and your student ID number?
questionVariations: Could you please confirm your passport number and student ID number?
For verification purposes, can you tell me your passport number and university student ID?
Before we proceed, could you provide your passport number and student identification number?
questions.expectedAnswer: My passport number is A18614754, and my student ID number is 500805024.

questions.question: Where will you be studying?
questionVariations: Could you please tell me which university you will be studying at and where it is located?
Which university have you chosen for your studies in the UK, and in which city is it located?
Can you confirm the name and location of the university where you intend to study?
questions.expectedAnswer: I’ll be studying at Bangor University, which is located in Bangor, North Wales, in the United Kingdom.

questions.question: What is the name of your course?
questionVariations: Could you please tell me the full name of the course you have chosen to study at Bangor University?
Which postgraduate programme have you applied for at Bangor University?
Can you confirm the exact title of the master's degree you intend to pursue in the UK?
questions.expectedAnswer: The name of my course is MSc Advanced Data Science.

questions.question: When does the course start and end?
questionVariations: Could you please confirm the official start date and end date of your course according to your offer letter?
On what date is your MSc Advanced Data Science programme scheduled to begin, and when will it finish?
Can you tell me the exact commencement and completion dates of your course at Bangor University?
questions.expectedAnswer: According to my offer letter, my course starts on the 18th of January 2027 and ends on the 1st of February 2028.

questions.question: What is the duration of your course?
questionVariations: How long will it take you to complete your MSc Advanced Data Science at Bangor University?
Is your master's programme full-time or part-time, and what is its duration?
Could you confirm the total length of your postgraduate programme?
questions.expectedAnswer: It's a full-time MSc in advanced data science, and its duration is one-year full-time course.

questions.question: How much is your full tuition fee? Can you give a breakdown of the fees for the full course?
questionVariations: Could you please tell me the total tuition fee for your MSc Advanced Data Science course and explain how much you need to pay after your scholarship?
What is the original tuition fee for your course at Bangor University, how much scholarship have you received, and what is your remaining tuition fee?
Can you provide a breakdown of your course fees, including the total tuition fee, scholarship amount, and the final amount payable?
questions.expectedAnswer: The total tuition fee for my MSc Advanced Data Science course at Bangor University is £20,500. However, I have received a £6,000 scholarship from the university, which reduces my tuition fee to £14,500.

questions.question: Will you attend online classes from your home country if the university requests?
questionVariations: If Bangor University asks you to attend online classes while you are still in Bangladesh, would you be willing to do so?
Would you agree to begin your studies online from your home country if the university required it?
How would you respond if your university instructed you to attend classes remotely before travelling to the UK?
questions.expectedAnswer: Yes, definitely. If the university asks me to attend online classes from my home country, I will definitely follow their instructions and attend the classes

questions.question: What is the full form of CAS?
questionVariations: Could you please explain what CAS stands for in the UK student visa application process?
What does the abbreviation CAS mean in relation to studying in the United Kingdom?
Can you tell me the full meaning of CAS, which is required for your UK Student visa application?
questions.expectedAnswer: CAS stands for Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies. It is an official electronic document issued by the university, and I need it to apply for my UK Student visa.

questions.question: How many credits do you need to complete your degree?
questionVariations: Could you please tell me the total number of academic credits required to complete your MSc Advanced Data Science degree at Bangor University?
How many credits must you successfully complete to be awarded your master's degree?
Can you confirm the total credit requirement for your postgraduate programme at Bangor University?
questions.expectedAnswer: I need to complete a total of 180 credits to obtain my MSc degree.

questions.question: What qualification will you receive?
questionVariations: Could you please tell me which academic qualification you will be awarded after successfully completing your course at Bangor University?
What degree will you obtain upon successful completion of your MSc Advanced Data Science programme?
Can you confirm the full title of the qualification you expect to receive from Bangor University after completing your studies?
questions.expectedAnswer: After successfully completing my course, I'll receive a Master of Science degree in Advanced Data Science from Bangor University.

questions.question: Do you know the level of your course?
questionVariations: Could you please confirm the academic level of your MSc Advanced Data Science course under the UK's Regulated Qualifications Framework?
What RQF level is your master's degree at Bangor University?
Are you aware of the qualification level of your postgraduate programme in the UK?
questions.expectedAnswer: Yes, my MSc Advanced Data Science course is a Level 7 postgraduate qualification under the UK's Regulated Qualifications Framework, or RQF.

questions.question: Are you aware of your course? Tell me about your course modules.
questionVariations: Could you please explain the structure of your MSc Advanced Data Science course at Bangor University, including the modules and their credit values?
What subjects will you study during your master's programme, and how many credits are allocated to each module and your final project?
Can you demonstrate your understanding of your chosen course by describing its compulsory modules, total credits, and individual research project?
questions.expectedAnswer:
Yes, I am fully aware of my course and its modules. I will study the MSc Advanced Data Science at Bangor University. The course is worth 180 credits and includes six compulsory modules and a 60-credit individual project.

The six compulsory modules are:

Information Visualisation, 20 credits
High Performance Computing, 20 credits
Data Science, 20 credits
Natural Language Processing, 20 credits
Machine Learning, 20 credits
Advanced Research Methods, 20 credits

In addition, I will complete the MSc Individual Project, which is worth 60 credits.
